title: Learning Causal Structure of Time Series using Best Order Score Search
abstract: arXiv:2603.05370v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal structure learning from observational data is central to many scientific and policy domains, but the time series setting common to many disciplines poses several challenges due to temporal dependence. In this paper we focus on score-based causal discovery for multivariate time series and introduce TS-BOSS, a time series extension of the recently proposed Best Order Score Search (BOSS) (Andrews et al. 2023). TS-BOSS performs a permutation-based search over dynamic Bayesian network structures while leveraging grow-shrink trees to cache intermediate score computations, preserving the scalability and strong empirical performance of BOSS in the static setting. We provide theoretical guarantees establishing the soundness of TS-BOSS under suitable assumptions, and we present an intermediate result that extends classical subgraph minimality results for permutation-based methods to the dynamic (time series) setting. translated_title: 基于最优序分数搜索的时间序列因果结构学习
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中学习因果结构是许多科学和政策领域的核心问题，但许多学科中常见的时间序列设置由于时间依赖性而带来了若干挑战。在本文中，我们聚焦于基于分数的多变量时间序列因果发现，并提出了TS-BOSS，这是最近提出的最佳序分数搜索（Best Order Score Search, BOSS）（Andrews et al. 2023）的时间序列扩展版本。TS-BOSS在动态贝叶斯网络结构上执行基于置换的搜索，同时利用生长-收缩树来缓存中间分数计算，从而在时间序列设置中保留了BOSS在静态设置中的可扩展性和出色的实证性能。我们提供了理论保证，证明了在适当假设下TS-BOSS的可靠性，并给出了一个中间结果，将基于置换方法的经典子图最小性结果扩展到了动态（时间序列）设置中。我们的实验……
tldr: 本文提出TS-BOSS算法，将最优序分数搜索（BOSS）扩展到多变量时间序列的动态贝叶斯网络因果结构学习中，兼具可扩展性与理论保证。
